national-snapshot.g: States, union territories, languages and land area at a glance.
national-snapshot.d: Constitutional and near-fixed reference facts about the Republic of India.

demographics-population.g: Population, births and life expectancy from SRS and the Census.
demographics-population.d: Yearly Sample Registration System (SRS) bulletins and the ten-yearly Census. SRS gives birth, death and infant death rates and life expectancy every year; the Census gives the full picture by age and sex.

economy-gdp.g: Quarterly GDP, GVA and growth by sector from MoSPI.
economy-gdp.d: Real and nominal GDP, gross value added by sector, and growth on the last quarter and the last year, from MoSPI press notes released at the end of February, May, August and November.

economy-inflation.g: Monthly CPI and WPI inflation from MoSPI and DPIIT.
economy-inflation.d: Consumer prices (CPI: combined, rural and urban) come out on the 12th and wholesale prices (WPI) on the 14th of each month. The headline figure is the change from a year earlier.

economy-employment.g: Work participation and unemployment from MoSPI's labour survey.
economy-employment.d: The monthly bulletin of the Periodic Labour Force Survey: labour force participation, the worker population ratio and the unemployment rate by current weekly status.

budget-union.g: Yearly Union Budget allocations and monthly actual spending.
budget-union.d: Total spending, the revenue and capital split, and the ten ministries with the biggest allocations. The Controller General of Accounts tracks actual receipts against the estimates every month.

budget-gst.g: Monthly gross GST collection, split by CGST, SGST and IGST.
budget-gst.d: Gross GST collected (CGST, SGST, IGST and cess), published by the GST Council and the Ministry of Finance on the 1st of each month.

agriculture-production.d: Advance estimates of crop production from the Department of Agriculture (DA&FW), released four times a year. The number of mandis is tracked monthly through AGMARKNET.

agriculture-plantation.g: Tea, coffee, rubber and spices: production and exports.
agriculture-plantation.d: Commodity board data for India's plantation sector. The Tea, Coffee, Rubber and Spices boards each publish a yearly statistics report.

agriculture-pmkisan.g: Farmers helped and money paid so far.
agriculture-pmkisan.d: Direct income support for small and marginal farmers. The PM-KISAN portal publishes the total number of farmers helped and instalments paid.

livestock-census.g: Livestock Census and NDDB milk production.
livestock-census.d: The five-yearly Livestock Census and yearly NDDB dairy data: milk production by state, the breed registry and cooperative reach.

livestock-fisheries.g: Inland and marine fish production and exports.
livestock-fisheries.d: Yearly data from the Department of Fisheries: production by state, exports and PMMSY beneficiaries.

wildlife-forests.g: Forest cover from FSI's India State of Forest Report, published every two years.
wildlife-forests.d: Total forest cover, tree cover, and the split between very dense, moderately dense and open forest, from FSI's India State of Forest Report.

wildlife-tigers.g: Tiger reserves and population estimates from NTCA.
wildlife-tigers.d: Tiger population estimates (Status of Tigers, every four years), tiger reserves and conservation funding through NTCA.

wildlife-protected-areas.g: The protected area network: parks, sanctuaries and Ramsar sites.
wildlife-protected-areas.d: The Wildlife Institute of India's list of all protected areas, plus Ramsar wetlands and biosphere reserves.

infra-roads.g: National highway length and NHAI projects.
infra-roads.d: MoRTH quarterly status: total national highway length, ongoing projects and their value, and expressways under construction.

infra-railways.g: Network length, passengers and freight from Indian Railways.
infra-railways.d: The Indian Railways yearbook: track length, electrification, passengers carried and freight loaded.

infra-aviation.g: Monthly air traffic, planes and airports from DGCA.
infra-aviation.d: DGCA monthly performance report: passengers by airport, domestic and international, and fleet size by airline.

infra-ports.g: Cargo at major and smaller ports.
infra-ports.d: Indian Ports Association data on cargo handled, container traffic and ship calls at the 12 major ports, plus the smaller ports run by states.

infra-telecom.g: Phone and broadband subscribers from TRAI.
infra-telecom.d: TRAI performance indicators report: wireless and wireline subscribers, the urban and rural split, and broadband and fibre reach.

infra-smart-cities.g: Projects finished and money used across the mission's cities.
infra-smart-cities.d: Smart Cities Mission dashboard: projects sanctioned, finished and under way, and funds released against funds used.

energy-power.g: Installed capacity and generation by source from CEA.
energy-power.d: CEA monthly summary: total installed capacity, monthly generation from thermal, hydro, nuclear and renewable sources, and peak demand.

energy-renewables.g: Installed solar, wind and other clean power from MNRE.
energy-renewables.d: MNRE monthly bulletin: solar (large plants and rooftops), wind, biomass, small hydro and total renewable capacity.

energy-fuels.g: Crude imports, fuel use and retail prices.
energy-fuels.d: PPAC monthly snapshot: crude imports, refinery output, petrol, diesel and LPG use, and retail price ranges.

energy-coal.g: Coal mined, coal sent out, and stock at power plants.
energy-coal.d: Ministry of Coal monthly data: coal mined in India, imports, coal sent to power plants and stock held at coal power stations.

health-overview.g: Key NFHS-5 figures and National Health Mission coverage.
health-overview.d: NFHS-5 figures on child growth, child deaths and vaccination coverage. National totals, with state figures inside.

health-pmjay.g: Cards issued, hospitals on the scheme and treatments approved.
health-pmjay.d: NHA monthly dashboard: Ayushman cards issued, hospitals on the scheme and hospital stays approved.

health-immunisation.g: People registered on U-WIN so far.
health-immunisation.d: The national vaccination registry: people registered, doses given and coverage for each vaccine.

education-schools.g: Schools, enrolment and facilities from UDISE+.
education-schools.d: The yearly UDISE+ school census: total schools, enrolment by stage, facilities (toilets, electricity, computers) and teachers.

education-higher.g: Students, colleges and enrolment ratio from AISHE.
education-higher.d: The All India Survey on Higher Education: enrolment, the enrolment ratio by gender and social group, and recognised universities and colleges.

education-skills.g: PMKVY trainees, ITI seats and certificates.
education-skills.d: Ministry of Skill Development data: people trained and placed under PMKVY, ITI seats and admissions, and NSDC scheme reach.

defence-budget.g: Capital and revenue allocations in the Union Budget.
defence-budget.d: Defence allocations in the Union Budget (Demands 17, 19 and 20): the total, capital spending and modernisation. Public figures only.

defence-exports.g: Defence export totals released through PIB.
defence-exports.d: Defence export totals released by the Ministry of Defence through PIB. Quarterly, total value only.

defence-dpsu.g: HAL, BEL, Mazagon and other listed defence PSUs.
defence-dpsu.d: Annual report figures from listed defence public sector companies (HAL, BEL, Mazagon Dock, Cochin Shipyard and others): revenue, profit and order book.

justice-pendency.d: National Judicial Data Grid weekly snapshot: total pending cases across district courts, high courts and the Supreme Court. Totals only.

justice-crime.g: Headline figures from the yearly Crime in India report.
justice-crime.d: The National Crime Records Bureau's Crime in India report: total cases under the penal code and the rate per lakh people. Released once a year as a scanned PDF.

justice-police.g: Sanctioned and actual police strength from BPRD.
justice-police.d: Yearly Bureau of Police Research and Development data on police forces: strength, vacancies and police per lakh people.

justice-prisons.g: Headline figures from NCRB's Prison Statistics India.
justice-prisons.d: NCRB's yearly Prison Statistics: total prisoners, undertrials, convicts and how full prisons are.

elections-loksabha.g: Seats held by each party, and vacancies.
elections-loksabha.d: Election Commission of India data on the current Lok Sabha: seats by party, vacancies and by-election results.

elections-rajyasabha.g: Party strength in the Council of States.
elections-rajyasabha.d: Rajya Sabha membership: strength by party, elected and nominated members, and vacancies.

elections-turnout.g: Past Lok Sabha and state turnout from ECI.
elections-turnout.d: Long-run voter turnout for Lok Sabha and state assembly elections, from the Election Commission's statistical reports.

science-isro.d: ISRO missions by year, recent launches and active satellites. Updated after each launch.

science-rd.g: Money spent on research, and patents granted.
science-rd.d: Department of Science and Technology research statistics: research spending as a share of GDP, and patents filed and granted through IP India.

science-startups.d: Startups recognised by Startup India and DPIIT: the total, by sector, by state, and growth over the year.

science-digital.g: Monthly UPI payments and Aadhaar enrolment.
science-digital.d: UPI payment count and value (NPCI, monthly), and Aadhaar enrolment and checks (UIDAI).

trade-overview.g: Monthly exports, imports and the trade balance.
trade-overview.d: Department of Commerce quick estimates: monthly goods exports and imports, services trade and the trade balance.

trade-fdi.g: Foreign investment by sector and source country.
trade-fdi.d: DPIIT foreign investment data: quarterly equity inflows by sector and source country, and RBI capital account data.

trade-diaspora.g: Money sent home, and Indians abroad.
trade-diaspora.d: RBI yearly remittance data and Ministry of External Affairs estimates of Indians abroad, by country.

tourism-overview.g: Monthly foreign tourist arrivals and earnings from the Ministry of Tourism.
tourism-overview.d: Foreign tourist arrivals and foreign exchange earnings, from the Ministry of Tourism's monthly bulletin.

tourism-heritage.g: Protected monuments and World Heritage Sites.
tourism-heritage.d: Archaeological Survey of India data on centrally protected monuments, plus India's UNESCO World Heritage Sites.

tourism-gi-tags.d: The Geographical Indications registry: total tags, by category and by state.

sports-olympics.d: India's Olympic and Paralympic record: medals by Games, team size and results by sport.

sports-khelo-india.g: Khelo India Games and training centres.
sports-khelo-india.d: Khelo India programme data: Games held, accredited training centres (KISCE) and athletes supported, by sport.

know-india-constitution.g: The Preamble, Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles and Schedules, explained from NCERT.
know-india-constitution.d: A picture-first guide, in line with NCERT, to the Preamble, Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles and how the Constitution is laid out.

know-india-history-timeline.g: From the Indus Valley to today: the master timeline of Indian civilisation.
know-india-history-timeline.d: A picture-first overview, in line with NCERT, from the Indus Valley (3300 BCE) to after Independence. It links to deeper guides on each era.

know-india-geography-physical.g: Rivers, mountains, climate zones and natural regions, explained.
know-india-geography-physical.d: A picture-first guide, in line with NCERT, to India's physical geography: river systems, mountain ranges, climate zones and natural regions.

know-india-parliament.g: Sessions, kinds of bills, committees and question hour, explained.
know-india-parliament.d: A picture-first guide, in line with NCERT, to how Parliament works: the Lok Sabha, the Rajya Sabha, bills, committees and question hour.

know-india-elections.g: Lok Sabha, state and local elections: the machinery from ECI to EVM.
know-india-elections.d: A picture-first guide, in line with NCERT, to India's election system: the Election Commission, the Model Code of Conduct, EVMs, VVPATs and voter registration.

know-india-budget.t: How the Union Budget is made
know-india-budget.g: Article 112, the budget cycle and Demands for Grants, explained.
know-india-budget.d: A picture-first guide, in line with NCERT, to how the Union Budget is made: Article 112, the budget cycle, who does what, and the Finance Bill.
